title: Wijha – Dispatch Engine
description: Turning operational decisions into explainable assignments.

preview.problem: Once a work item enters the system, the hard question is who should handle it, and why them.
did: Designed how the engine's reasoning (eligibility, fit, cost, balance) is shown to a person.
Kept every assignment traceable and the final decision human-controlled.

title: Fan-ID – AFC Asian Cup
description: Benchmarking, fan journey and UX principles for a tournament-wide digital identity, taken through to a proof of concept.

facts: UX Designer, with a Product Designer (UI)
preview.problem: Fans cross airports, hotels, fan zones, metro lines and stadium gates, and one Fan-ID had to work at every one of them.
did: Built the research foundation: four tournaments benchmarked against 14 criteria.
Mapped the eight-stage fan journey and wrote five UX principles.

title: Film Saudi – UX Audit
description: A heuristic evaluation of a film-industry platform: 10 findings rated by severity, with recommendations, an improved journey, flows and information architecture.

facts: UX Designer, with a Product Designer
preview.problem: To use a film incentive in Saudi Arabia, a filmmaker moves across three platforms, and the journey breaks in several places.
did: Ran a heuristic evaluation of four areas and rated 10 findings by severity.
Redrew the journey, the user flows and the information architecture.

title: STC Inspector – Field Inspection MVP
description: One workflow for the inspector on site and the admin behind the desk, delivered as an MVP.

preview.problem: The inspector works in the field. The admin assigns, reviews and closes each inspection. The product had to keep both in step.
did: Wrote the user stories and the flows for the inspector app and the admin hub.
Followed the design through developer reviews until hand-off.

title: Smart Book Fair – Digital Visitor Experience
description: A complete digital visitor experience, from the QR scan at the entrance to the exit.

preview.problem: Digital tools that give visitors ease of access, navigation and interaction with the fair, with gamification and crowd-management strategies.
did: The visitor journey from the QR scan to the exit.
Five key features, each with its added value for the visitor and the organiser.
An admin dashboard for the fair's management team.

title: Redesign Task
description: A case study on redesigning the Instalments and Card Activation flows in the TRU app, based on user research and analytics.

title: Banktica – Fintech App
description: A comprehensive mobile fintech application that gives users a seamless, intuitive way to manage their financial activities.

title: New Features, InDrive App
description: New payment options for a transportation app: credit card, PayPal and wallet.

title: NexMoney App
